full_judgment: 8. Considering the above submissions made by the learned Advocate of the opposite parties and also considering the revisional application field under Section 115(1) of the Code of Civil Procedure along with Annexures therein, in particular, the impugned judgment and decree passed by the appellate Court and also considering the materials in the lower Court records, it appears to me that the present opposite party field a title suit with a prayer for Specific Performance of Contract being a bainapatra dated 16.01.2003 for purchase of the land measuring 34 decimals situated in C.S. and S.A. Dag No.737 under Khatian No.397, R.S. No.1126, Mouza Madabpur, Police Station and Registration Office-Singair, District-Manikganj was owned by the present defendant by way of purchase. The said defendant-opposite party expressed his intention to sale the suit land and the present petitioner expressed his intention to purchase the land by fixing price of the land at taka 1,90,000/- (one lakh ninety thousand) only and Taka 1,75,000/- (one lakh seventy five thousand) only was paid on the date of bainapatra.
